title: alchemilla glaberrima var. sericoneura
intro: Alchemilla glaberrima var. sericoneura, commonly known as a specific variety of the Lady's Mantle plant, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and acting as a diuretic. It is also known for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla glaberrima var. sericoneura include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
